citationText: 29. The American standard was different. It was designed to operate on the fourth-order shelf with a 7.9-MHz carrier frequency; sync tip was 7.05 MHz and peak white was 10 MHz. Pre-emphasis boost of subcarrier was 8 dB and the — 3 dB point was 4.5 MHz. Signal-to-noise ratio, unweighted, was 46 dB.
